name: Necrogen Rotpriest

abilities.text: Whenever a creature you control with toxic deals combat damage to a player, that player gets an additional poison counter.
{1}{B}{G}: Target creature you control with toxic gains deathtouch until end of turn.

notes: A non-self `combat-damage-player` trigger already restricts the damaging creature to one its controller controls (game.ts:2165), so the filter carries only 'creature with toxic'.

issues: Whenever a creature you control with toxic deals combat damage to a player, that player gets an additional poison counter. — expected fires for any toxic creature its controller controls, INCLUDING Necrogen Rotpriest itself — scripted combat-damage-player, self:false + filter — verified at game.ts:2172, which applies ctx.obj.controller === perm.controller and has no `ctx.obj !== perm` exclusion, so the source's own damage triggers it. The notes claim (cited as game.ts:2165) is accurate apart from the line number drift. — CR 603.2

...an additional poison counter. — expected exactly 1, to the damaged player — scripted poison { amount: 1, who: 'that-player' }, which game.ts:1211 routes to item.triggeringPlayer — correct — CR 104.3c

{1}{B}{G}: Target creature you control with toxic gains deathtouch until end of turn. — expected instant-speed, repeatable, controller-restricted, toxic-restricted, eot duration — scripted activated, mana {1}{B}{G}, grant-keyword deathtouch, target kind creature controller:you filter withKeyword toxic, duration eot — all present; renders 1.00 — CR 702.2b
